snippet.title: ⨻HATONE⨻ I made my first game ! [Official Gameplay Trailer]
snippet.description:
Hatone - a NES-inspired short Action-Platformer game with metroidvania elements. Play as an Illuminati henchman battling fearsome bosses and unearthing secrets in an ancient castle. Fulfill your duty… but are you the architect of your fate—or just a pawn in a game someone else is playing? 
-
Game pages:
✔️Steam - [https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478860/Hatone/]
-
-
 I'm previewing my new game, ⨻HATONE⨻. This is the first game I've ever created (almost alone) in which I practiced making games. I gained experience, from scratch, in programming skills, game design in different areas, etc.
-
[Music in the trailer: X-Ray - Zizibum]
-
🎫Press Kit - [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xjXiNRo8uVuSWWoeywPVHk8WXyqQMwFi?usp=sharing]
